prompt:
Our IoT gateway firmware team has a serious operational problem: all connection parameters (MQTT broker address, port, TLS flag, device ID, polling interval, retry count) are hardcoded directly in the legacy C source file at `legacy/v0.9/gateway.c`. Every time we deploy to a new environment, we have to recompile the entire firmware just to change an IP address.

We now have a config management library available in the workspace (`code.c`) and an existing config file at `config/gateway.cfg` that already contains most of the production values.

Please write a new C program called `gateway_main.c` that:
1. Loads all gateway parameters from `config/gateway.cfg` at startup
2. Prints all six parameters (broker, port, tls, device id, poll interval, retry max) to stdout so we can verify the values on boot
3. Uses sensible hardcoded fallback defaults for any parameters that might be absent from the config file (poll interval should default to 60 seconds, retry max to 3)
4. Compiles and runs correctly as a standalone program

The legacy values in `legacy/v0.9/gateway.c` are just for reference — the new program must get all its values from the config file, not from hardcoded assignments.
